name: VisIT-Bench
description: VisIT-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating instruction-following vision-language models on real-world tasks. It includes 70 instruction families and 592 test queries with human-authored instruction-conditioned captions, enabling both human-verified references and automatic evaluation using text-only LLMs.
reputation: A well-regarded benchmark for real-world instruction-following in vision-language models, often used to test open-ended multimodal grounding and captioning quality.
notes: Dynamic benchmark with a public leaderboard; evaluates instruction-following in vision-language models beyond standard datasets.
